column1: # Module candidates for the omega split (L396, ADR 0039 one thing per repo).
# One rule per line: <group><TAB><extended regex on the repo-relative path>.
# First match wins, so specific rules go above general ones. Read by tools/modules/graph.sh.
# Lines naming a subsystem with @ expand to ^(src|tests|tools|mk)/<name>([/_.-]|$).
# Shelves (no code): receipts, papers, calibration runs.
# CUDA++ (L395, MIT): the GPU toolchain, runtime and libraries. Fixed by L395; listed so edges show.
# GPU world/accelerator gates and the GB10 numeric kernels: GPU code filed beside the language today.
# The search-trace hook is the language's callback slot (omega_synthesis calls it); it stays with omega.
# Numeric: exact numbers, algebra, CPU vector/matvec realizations.
# Host adapter (OSH capability enforcement, aien-architecture#158 ABI).
# Resident runtime (rx_*: AIEN faculties, capability roots, ARGUS/AEGIS bindings).
# The language (stays in omega): Omegese, OSC, IR, checker2, compiler backends, program/resolve/realize/verify.
# Build glue, shared tests and tools that are not yet attributed to one module.
